query:
SELECT t.source_id,s.revision AS source_revision,t.upstream_name,t.path,t.description,t.read_only,t.destructive,
            (e.all_tools OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_tools scope WHERE scope.endpoint_id=e.id AND scope.source_id=t.source_id AND scope.upstream_name=t.upstream_name)) AS "in_scope!",p.action AS "override_action?: Action",
            CASE WHEN NOT e.all_tools AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_tools scope WHERE scope.endpoint_id=e.id AND scope.source_id=t.source_id AND scope.upstream_name=t.upstream_name) THEN 'block' ELSE COALESCE(p.action,CASE WHEN t.read_only THEN 'allow' WHEN t.destructive THEN 'approve' ELSE 'allow' END) END AS "effective_action!: Action"
            FROM tools t JOIN sources s ON s.id=t.source_id JOIN endpoints e ON e.id=$1 LEFT JOIN tool_policies p ON p.endpoint_id=e.id AND p.source_id=t.source_id AND p.upstream_name=t.upstream_name
            WHERE (e.all_sources OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_sources es WHERE es.endpoint_id=e.id AND es.source_id=t.source_id))
            AND ($2='' OR t.search @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple',$2)) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR t.path>$3) ORDER BY t.path LIMIT 51
